# PyLeap v1.1.0 Beta 6 Release Notes
## Notable changes to 1.1.0 Beta 6 since 1.1.0 Beta 5
### Developed using device(s):
Adafruit CircuitPython 7.2.5 - Adafruit Circuit Playground Bluefruit with nRF52840
Adafruit CircuitPython 7.2.5 - Adafruit CLUE nRF52840 Express with nRF52840

• Button Download/ Transfer title is now "Run it!" . This button now downloads a project bundle, then transfers project to Bluetooth device in one action.

• Project images are cached and resized for better scrolling and offline use. 

• PyLeap’s orientation is fixed to portrait for a better user scrolling experience. 

• Upon launch on MacOS, app crashes. Issue was resolved. Users can navigate the app normally.

• Sub-headers has been added to the view to display a global connect button and display current paired device.

• To illustrate to the user that PyLeap is in the process of downloading, a progress view has been added.

• Internet connection handling has been updated with new UI for the user.

• Addition of Bluetooth connection handling UI.
 
## For the next update PyLeap v1.1.0 beta 7
Will add a disconnection button to safely disconnect from paired device and remove peripheral information used for reconnection.

## Known issues
[Clicking Transfer doesn't result in code transfer and run until reset](https://github.com/adafruit/PyLeap-iOS/issues/18)
For more issues, see [PyLeap's Issues](https://github.com/adafruit/PyLeap-iOS/issues)

**The "Transfer" button (Now "Run it!" Button) resulted in transferring code, but the device needed to be reset in order for the code to run. This is a Circuit Python issue that will be addressed in the future.**

https://github.com/adafruit/circuitpython/issues/6258

## Documentation
Documentation is available in the [PyLeap Learn Guide](https://learn.adafruit.com/pyleap-app).

## Download
[Download PyLeap form the Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pyleap/id1582204203) 

## Thanks
Thank you to all who used and tested PyLeap.
